title: The In Vitro Anti-Inflammatory Activities of Galangin and Quercetin towards the LPS-Injured Rat Intestinal Epithelial (IEC-6) Cells as Affected by Heat Treatment.
authors: Cai, Shi-Qing; Zhang, Qiang; Zhao, Xin-Huai; Shi, Jia
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄酮醇类化合物对LPS诱导肠上皮细胞炎症的抑制作用，涉及TLR4/NF-κB信号通路和分子对接，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Flavonols possess several beneficial bioactivities in vitro and in vivo. In this study, two flavonols galangin and quercetin with or without heat treatment (100  degrees C for 15-30 min) were assessed for their anti-inflammatory activities in lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-stimulated rat intestinal epithelial (IEC-6) cells and whether the heat treatment caused activity changes. The flavonol dosages of 2.5-20 mumol/L had no cytotoxicity on the cells but could enhance cell viability (especially using 5 mumol/L flavonol dosage). The flavonols could decrease the production of prostaglandin E(2) and three pro-inflammatory cytokines interleukin-1beta (IL-1beta), IL-6, and tumor necrosis factor-alpha, and simultaneously promote the production of two anti-inflammatory cytokines IL-10 and transforming growth factor-beta. The Western-blot results verified that the flavonols could suppress the LPS-induced expression of TLR4 and phosphorylated IkappaBalpha and p65, while the molecular docking results also illustrated that the flavonols could bind with TLR4 and NF-kappaB to yield energy decreases of -(21.9-28.6) kJ/mol. Furthermore, an inhibitor BAY 11-7082 blocked the NF-kappaB signaling pathway by inhibiting the expression of phosphorylated IkappaBalpha/p65 and thus mediated the production of IL-6/IL-10 as the flavonols did, which confirmed the assessed anti-inflammatory effect of the flavonols. Consistently, galangin had higher anti-inflammatory activity than quercetin, while the heated flavonols (especially those with longer heat time) were less active than the unheated counterparts to exert these target anti-inflammatory effects. It is highlighted that the flavonols could antagonize the LPS-caused IEC-6 cells inflammation via suppressing TLR4/NF-kappaB activation, but heat treatment of the flavonols led to reduced anti-inflammatory efficacy.
abstract_zh: 黄酮醇在体外和体内具有多种有益的生物活性。本研究评估了两种黄酮醇——高良姜素和槲皮素，在有无热处理（100°C，15-30分钟）条件下，对脂多糖（LPS）刺激的大鼠肠上皮（IEC-6）细胞的抗炎活性，并考察热处理是否引起活性变化。黄酮醇剂量为2.5-20 μmol/L时对细胞无细胞毒性，但能增强细胞活力（尤其是使用5 μmol/L黄酮醇剂量时）。黄酮醇能降低前列腺素E(2)及三种促炎细胞因子白细胞介素-1β（IL-1β）、IL-6和肿瘤坏死因子-α的产生，同时促进两种抗炎细胞因子IL-10和转化生长因子-β的生成。Western-blot结果证实，黄酮醇能抑制LPS诱导的TLR4及磷酸化IκBα和p65的表达，而分子对接结果也表明，黄酮醇能与TLR4和NF-κB结合，产生-(21.9-28.6) kJ/mol的能量降低。此外，抑制剂BAY 11-7082通过抑制磷酸化IκBα/p65的表达来阻断NF-κB信号通路，从而像黄酮醇一样调节IL-6/IL-10的产生，这证实了所评估的黄酮醇的抗炎作用。一致地，高良姜素的抗炎活性高于槲皮素，而热处理后的黄酮醇（尤其是热处理时间较长的）在发挥这些靶向抗炎效果方面活性低于未处理对应物。需要强调的是，黄酮醇通过抑制TLR4/NF-κB激活来拮抗LPS引起的IEC-6细胞炎症，但黄酮醇的热处理导致抗炎功效降低。
